    content = f.read()

    ''
)

import re
mru_pattern = r'class MRUCache\(Cache\):.*?(?=\n(?:class |def cached\(|def cachedmethod\())'
match = re.search(mru_pattern, content, re.DOTALL)
if match:
    content = content[:match.start()] + '\n\n' + content[match.end():]
    print(f"Removed MRUCache class (matched {len(match.group())} chars)")
else:
    print("Could not find MRUCache class")

with open('src/cachetools/__init__.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("__init__.py updated for m3")
